Mira: quick heads-up — our sample shows ESM resolved on edge but TS consumers lose types and `require()` shape differs. reproducible in samples/entrypoint-interop. anyone seen this? :eyes:

Devon: sounds like `exports` without `types` mapping. paste package.json exports?

Mira: minimal exports:
```json
"exports": { ".": { "import": "./dist/esm/index.js", "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js" }, "./package.json": "./package.json" }
```
Top-level `types` is present but editors downstream can't find declarations when bundler-style resolution runs.

Ben K: add `types` under `exports` — TS bundler resolution will pick it up. Also add a tiny CJS bridge to normalize default.

Chandra R: add CI checks: TS compile with `moduleResolution: bundler` and a small node require/import parity test on Node 14/16. lightweight but catches regressions.

Mira: will open PR: 1) add `exports.types`, 2) add small `dist/cjs` bridge that normalizes default, 3) add TS bundler compile + node shape tests, 4) a devex note in publish playbook.

CI Bot: samples-ci/entrypoint-interop previously failed edge-smoke: https://ci.redwood.dev/edge-452 :x:

Ben K: also add a package.json lint in CI that errors if top-level `types` exists but `exports` has no `types` mapping. small guard.

Mira: thanks — PR incoming and i'll tag reviewers. :raised_hands:
